# ND-500

ND-500 micro program, 144-bit word, control store 8K

| | |
|---|---|
| Name for `%#MODEL` and the settings | `nd500` |
| Also accepted | `nd-500` |
| Word width in the bit view | 144 bits |
| Image written by *Assemble* | packed18, 147456 bytes |
| Ending of the image file | `.CODE` |
| Mnemonics | 721 |
| Colours shared with | ND-500 and ND-5000 |
| Definitions | [`defs/tokens/nd500-tokens.yaml`](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/nd-microcode-meta/blob/main/defs/tokens/nd500-tokens.yaml) |

## How the bits are given

The word is 9 groups of 16 bits. Each group is written as 6 octal digits, most significant group first. Groups that are all zero are left out of the tables below. A mnemonic sets the bits that are 1 in its groups; the mnemonics of one instruction are ORed together.

| `BSUB` | 121:116 | B operand sub select |

| `DSUB` | 112:106 | destination sub select |
| `IXSEL` | 117:116 | index register select (overlays BSUB bits 1-0) |
| `CARRY_FALSE` | 41:40 | alternative carry select (overlays EXUNIT) |
| `ALU_FALSE` | 36:32 | alternative ALU function (overlays EXFUNC) |
| `EA2INH` | 31 | EA2 clock inhibit (argument area bit 31) |
| `EA1INH` | 30 | EA1 clock inhibit (argument area bit 30) |
| `CSA_ADDRESS` | 29:16 | absolute micro program address |
| `SHORT_ARGUMENT` | 15:0 | short argument |
